docs.summary: Global editor settings. Saved to AppData/Prowl/EditorSettings.json. Persists across projects. Contains preferences and the active theme.

members.name: Instance
members.signature: public static EditorSettings Instance { get; internal set; }

docs.summary: Gets or sets the default directory for new projects. Defaults to Documents/ProwlProjects.
Gets or sets the thumbnail size in pixels for asset previews. Defaults to 32.
Gets or sets the editor window X position in screen coordinates. -1 means auto-place.
Gets or sets the editor window Y position in screen coordinates. -1 means auto-place.
Gets or sets the editor window width in pixels. Defaults to 1280.
Gets or sets the editor window height in pixels. Defaults to 800.
Gets or sets whether the editor waits for the display before presenting a frame. Play mode ignores this and lets the game decide.
Gets or sets the frame rate the editor is paced to. 0 is unlimited. Play mode ignores this and lets the game decide.
Gets or sets the frame rate the editor is paced to while its window is not focused. 0 means no separate limit. Play mode ignores this and lets the game decide.
Gets or sets whether the prowl CLI may run arbitrary C# in the editor through eval.

members.name: ShortcutOverrides
members.signature: public Dictionary<string, ShortcutBinding> ShortcutOverrides { get; set; }

docs.summary: Gets or sets the dictionary of user-overridden shortcut bindings, keyed by action name. Only overridden bindings are stored.
Gets or sets whether the first launch editor setup has been shown.

members.name: SceneToolSettings
members.signature: public Dictionary<string, string> SceneToolSettings { get; set; }

docs.summary: Serialized per-scene-tool settings, keyed by settings type name. Per-user rather than per-project: a brush size follows the user, it is not committed with the scene.
Gets or sets the current editor theme data. Defaults to the built-in theme.
Themes the user saved under their own names.
Layout densities the user saved under their own names.
Prepares the color ramps of the current and saved themes after loading.
Apply the current theme to EditorTheme's static fields.
Serializes this instance to the editor settings JSON file on disk. Silently logs a warning on failure.
Swaps in other settings, such as an imported profile or a full reset, and applies them everywhere. This machine's window placement and projects folder are kept, and a finished setup stays finished.
Resets the theme to the default, applies it, and saves the settings.
